# Navigation tools

6 tools. Not registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`; ask for it by name with `GODOT_MCP_CATEGORIES=navigation`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `add_navigation_region`

Add a NavigationRegion3D or NavigationRegion2D node with an empty navigation mesh/polygon. Call bake_navigation afterward to populate the walkable area from scene geometry.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `parent_path` | `string` | — | Path to parent node (default: scene root) |
| `node_name` | `string` | — | Name for the new node (default: 'NavigationRegion3D' or 'NavigationRegion2D') |
| `dimension` | `string` | — | Whether to create a 3D or 2D region (default: '3d') One of: `"3d"`, `"2d"`. |
| `navigation_layers` | `integer`, `array` | — | Navigation layers this region belongs to (default: layer 1). Agents can only traverse regions on matching layers. Array items are `integer`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/13-navigation.json`, test NAV-01:

```json
{
  "parent_path": ".",
  "node_name": "NavRegion",
  "dimension": "2d"
}
```

## `add_navigation_agent`

Add a NavigationAgent3D or NavigationAgent2D to a parent node. The agent computes paths and steers its parent toward a target_position. Attach it to a CharacterBody or similar movement node.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `parent_path` | `string` | — | Path to the character node that will own this agent (default: scene root) |
| `node_name` | `string` | — | Name for the agent node (default: 'NavigationAgent3D' or 'NavigationAgent2D') |
| `dimension` | `string` | — | Whether to create a 3D or 2D agent (default: '3d') One of: `"3d"`, `"2d"`. |
| `max_speed` | `number` | — | Maximum movement speed in units/second (default: 200.0) |
| `path_desired_distance` | `number` | — | Distance in units at which a path waypoint is considered reached (default: 1.0) |
| `target_desired_distance` | `number` | — | Distance in units at which the final target is considered reached (default: 1.0) |
| `navigation_layers` | `integer`, `array` | — | Navigation layers the agent can traverse (default: layer 1) Array items are `integer`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/13-navigation.json`, test NAV-02:

```json
{
  "parent_path": ".",
  "node_name": "NavAgent",
  "dimension": "2d"
}
```

## `bake_navigation`

Bake the navigation mesh or polygon for a NavigationRegion node. For 3D, scans MeshInstance3D children and builds a walkable mesh; for 2D, bakes from the polygon outline. Must have geometry in the region's subtree to produce a non-empty result.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the NavigationRegion3D or NavigationRegion2D node to bake |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/13-navigation.json`, test NAV-06:

```json
{
  "node_path": "NavRegion"
}
```

## `set_navigation_layer`

Set the navigation_layers bitmask on a NavigationRegion, NavigationAgent, or NavigationObstacle node. Agents only traverse regions on matching layers, enabling multi-floor or multi-group navigation.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the NavigationRegion3D/2D or NavigationAgent3D/2D node |
| `navigation_layers` | `integer`, `array` | yes | Bitmask (3 = layers 1+2) or 1-based layer numbers ([1, 3]) Array items are `integer`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/13-navigation.json`, test NAV-03:

```json
{
  "node_path": "NavRegion",
  "navigation_layers": [
    1
  ]
}
```

## `get_navigation_path`

Query the navigation server for a walkable path between two positions. Returns an ordered array of waypoints. Requires at least one NavigationRegion with a baked mesh in the scene; returns an empty path if no walkable route exists.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `from` | `object`, `string`, `array` | yes | Start position. Vector2 or Vector3 as {x, y[, z]}, "Vector3(0, 2, 5)", or [x, y[, z]] Array items are `number`. |
| `to` | `object`, `string`, `array` | yes | Target position. Vector2 or Vector3 as {x, y[, z]}, "Vector3(0, 2, 5)", or [x, y[, z]] Array items are `number`. |
| `dimension` | `string` | — | Navigation server to use: '3d' (default) or '2d'. Must match the region type. One of: `"3d"`, `"2d"`. |
| `navigation_layers` | `integer`, `array` | — | Restrict the path to regions on these navigation layers (default: layer 1) Array items are `integer`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/13-navigation.json`, test NAV-05:

```json
{
  "from": "Vector2(0, 0)",
  "to": "Vector2(100, 100)",
  "dimension": "2d"
}
```

## `get_navigation_info`

Get navigation configuration for a specific node, or scan the entire scene and return all NavigationRegion and NavigationAgent nodes with their layer and mesh settings.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | — | Path to a NavigationRegion or NavigationAgent node for per-node details. Omit to scan the whole scene. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/13-navigation.json`, test NAV-04:

```json
{}
```
